exposure: endometrial preparation method (Natural Cycle vs. Hormone Replacement Cycle)
outcome: perinatal complications (postpartum hemorrhage, placenta accreta spectrum)
cohort: The study included 306 successful frozen-thawed embryo transfer (FET) pregnancies from 2017 to 2022.
finding: Hormone Replacement Cycle (HRC) was associated with significantly higher rates of postpartum hemorrhage and placenta accreta spectrum, but serum E2 and P4 levels during FET did not correlate with perinatal complications.
